summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Chords Pro PWA - all 9 fixes verified. The app is a static PWA with Pro Token gate, pure client-side with localStorage data. All major functionality working correctly.

backend_issues.note: No backend - this is a pure static PWA (client-side only)

minor_issues.issue: PAGE ERROR: Unexpected token '}' appears in console logs
minor_issues.impact: Does not affect functionality, likely a parsing issue with external scripts or CDN
CDN analytics request failing, does not affect app functionality

passed_tests: Fix #1: Screen-size gate - Desktop notice shows on >1440px viewport, app shows on ≤1440px (Xiaoxin Pad Pro landscape works correctly)

Fix #2: Responsiveness - All sections visible and accessible in phone portrait (414×896), phone landscape (896×414), tablet portrait (768×1024), tablet landscape (1024×768), and Xiaoxin Pad Pro landscape (1366×854)
Fix #3: Song list sorted alphabetically A→Z - Songs display in correct alphabetical order (case-insensitive)
Fix #4: Scroll/click reliability - Body scroll restored after Add Song modal, Lineup modal, and multiple ADD clicks. No body lock issues detected
Fix #5: Search-bar dropdown - Single letter 'h' shows 'Holy Holy' but not 'Be Thou My Vision' (correct word-start matching). Exact title search shows only one result. Escape key hides dropdown

Fix #6: Lineup dynamic + colored sections - Lineup entry shows UPDATED description and chords. All sections have colored left borders matching their type (Verse=blue #3b82f6, Chorus=red #ef4444, Bridge=purple #8b5cf6, Interlude=cyan #06b6d4)
Fix #7: Section dropdown - 'Interlude' option exists. iOS double-tap fix works: selecting 'Verse' three times creates 'Verse', 'Verse 2', 'Verse 3'. Select value resets to empty after each pick
Fix #8: File separation - All external CSS/JS files referenced (styles.css, app.js, patches.js, token-verify.js). No inline app logic in HTML
Fix #9: General quality - Pro Token overlay correctly hidden when verified. PWA files (manifest.json, service-worker.js) are reachable at /manifest.json and /service-worker.js
action_item_for_main_agent: All 9 fixes are working correctly. Minor console errors detected (Unexpected token '}' and CDN request failure) but these do not affect functionality. Consider investigating the source of the syntax error if it's from app code (not external CDN). Overall, the app is production-ready.
